items.question: When are the fees under the MSA reviewed?
items.answer:
The fees under the MSA are reviewed on 1 April 2030 to the open market rent, according to the Unit 7 Lease [1].

The Harrowgate MSA does not specify a review date for fees, but it does state that the platform subscription fee is USD 18,500 per month [3].

The Kestrel Storage Services Agreement specifies a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month [4]. This clause was amended by Amendment No. 1, which changed the monthly storage fee to EUR 4,600 [2].
